page0.text:
There's a respectable dojo built within the Emiya house.
It was added as an afterthought when the entire house was being built.
It was nothing more than a hobby and indulgence.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page0:1

page1.text:
"Okay, then."
I'll do some light exercise before breakfast.
I'm not really studying martial arts, but my old man once told me,
"If you want to be like me, you'll need to harden your body."
Since then, I've made a point of working out every day.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page1:1

page2.text:
"Ninety-nine...one hundred."
I finish my daily sit-ups and change from my dougi into my school uniform.
Since I overslept, I decide to work out just enough to satisfy me.
A few sit-ups with no stretching should be enough.
I'm not built to bulk up, and no matter how important they say body building is, it's not like I want to get into fights.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page2:1

page3.text:
All I need is to gain enough athletic ability to handle unexpected situations, and be able to move the way my silly ideals require.
After all, the thing I most want to be is the complete opposite of an athlete.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page3:1

page4.text:
"...Oh. It's getting late."
I toss my sweaty dougi in the laundry hamper.
It's already twenty past six.
The Emiya household's mornings start early, so even this time would be considered late for breakfast.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page4:1

page5.text:
Breakfast is already prepared.
The appetizing scent of the breakfast Sakura cooked wafts toward me from the dining table.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page5:1

page6.text:
"You must have had a good workout. Breakfast is ready."
"Oh...thanks. Sorry I made you work more because I overslept."
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page6:1

page7.text: "It's no trouble. And you did not oversleep. You're not in any school clubs, so it's still early."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page7:1

page8.text:
"Clubs have nothing to do with it. And if they do, you coming by in the mornings must be a lot of trouble since you do have morning practice."
"Oh...well, I want to do this, so please don't worry about me."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page8:1

page9.text:
"Yeah. You keep telling me that, which is why I wake up early, club or no.
If you're coming by, it'd be rude to still be asleep."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page9:1

page10.text: To me, waking up early is waking up before Sakura gets here, and oversleeping means I make Sakura prepare breakfast on her own, like today.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page10:1

page11.text:
"Teehee. You really are a stickler about this kind of thing. Even Mitsuzuri-senpai says you're honest to a fault and annoying, even though you're so crude."
Mitsuzuri is the captain of the kyudou club Sakura is in, and she and I seem to cross paths often.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page11:1

page12.text:
"Hm. Is she still griping about me to you?"
"Yes. She's working hard every day to bring you to your knees with her archery skills before you graduate."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page12:1

page13.text:
"Is that so? She must be better than me by now. You know how memories get glorified. I don't mind the reverence, but I guess that depends on who sees me that way, too."
"Mitsuzuri-senpai is really competitive. I'm sure she sees you as competition."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page13:1

page14.text:
Sakura scoops rice into a bowl as she talks.
It's almost six thirty.
The kyudou club's morning practice starts at seven.
Attendance is not mandatory, but she doesn't have much time left.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page14:1

page15.text:
"Fuji-nee...should be here soon. Well, it's her fault for not being here on time. Sakura, let's go ahead and start eating."
"You're right. Here you go, Senpai."
Sakura hands me the rice bowl with a smile.
"...Ack."
Oops.
I should be used to this every morning, but her delicate fingers catch my attention.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page15:1

page16.text:
"...!"
...I can't explain it, but it's awkward.
I'm not sure if it's our age, but Sakura's been looking more provocative lately.
Her casual movements are so pretty, she often takes my breath away.
Maybe it's because I never saw Sakura that way before, but now I'm noticing how feminine she's becoming.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page16:1

page17.text:
"Senpai? Is something the matter?"
"No, it's nothing. Don't worry about it."
"Hm?"
...Honestly, it's baffling.
Why the hell am I getting nervous around my friend's younger sister?
Sakura's just a really good and considerate younger friend of mine, and she's someone I need to look after.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page17:1

page18.text: She's the younger sister of a friend of mine. We used to be friendly, though initially we weren't very close since she's a grade below me.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page18:1

page19.text:
It was only a year and a half ago that our relationship became more what it is now.
Sakura started to come and cook meals for me when I got hurt, and things kind of stayed like that.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page19:1

page20.text: I think this arrangement was supposed to last until I got better, but I guess something or other happened, and somehow she ended up helping out with household chores.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page20:1

page21.text:
Either way, Sakura's a good cook, and her cleaning and laundry skills are perfect.
Having her come early in the morning is a big help. But it's been disconcerting recently.
Sakura isn't the problem. It's me.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-02:page21:1
